incident-bot: :rotating_light: CONTINUOUS_BATCHER_ALERT us-east-1-gpupool-3 — queue growth > 25% for 3m, p95 latency 4.2s, model-infer errors increasing. Auto-scale attempted 2x, failed. Node flaps observed.
Sam (oncall): seeing same in the console, multiple pods restarting on gpu-node-7/8. paging spikes and OOM traces in journal.
Priya (eng-runtime): can someone paste the kube events and the container logs? suspect batch accumulator not releasing; might be prefetch thrash.
Jules (eng-sre): grabbing logs now, looks like repeated OOM kills on infer-server container: "OOMKilled" + kernel messages about cgroup.
Diego (infra): node kernel logs show repeated GPU page faults then a full process kill. snippet:
```
May 14 08:10:21 gpu-node-7 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 23456 (infer_server) total-vm:1234567kB, anon-rss:987654kB, file-rss:0kB
May 14 08:10:21 gpu-node-7 kernel: Killed process 23456 (infer_server) total-vm:1234567kB
```
Priya (eng-runtime): also seeing CUDA OOM in server logs before kill: ``
[E][cuda] 08:09:59 infer.cpp:412] CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 256M for attention_kv_cache
``
Sam (oncall): so timeline: batcher queue increased -> runtime attempted to allocate larger KV cache -> CUDA OOM -> process restart -> accumulator didn't clear -> queue persists.
Elena (support): we have 3 customers reporting higher latency and 1 reporting 502s, flagged support-high. Any ETA on mitigation?
Priya (eng-runtime): immediate mitigations: 1) scale down continuous-batcher workers to reduce accumulation 2) suspend prefetch paths 3) enable model-fallback to smaller quantized variant.
Sam (oncall): executing mitigations now. running:
```
kubectl -n redwood scale deploy continuous-batcher --replicas=1
kubectl patch deploy continuous-batcher -n redwood -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"batcher/prefetch":"disabled"}}}}}'
```
Jules (eng-sre): I'm cordoning gpu-node-7 and draining to stop flapping impact: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7` then `kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
Diego (infra): note: draining will evict other infer-server pods; we should reduce concurrency on those before they reschedule. Priya, can you set concurrency limit to 1 for fallback variant?
Priya (eng-runtime): doing patch now: `kubectl set env deploy/infer-server MAX_CONCURRENCY=1 -n redwood` and routing traffic to fallback-model-v2-quantized.
Sam (oncall): update: after scaling batcher to 1 and disabling prefetch, p95 dropped to 1.1s, error rate falling. node still logs occasional GPU pagefaults but no OOM kills in the last 3m.
Elena (support): telling customers it's a transient infra issue; asking for an incident severity and ETA.
Sam (oncall): severity P2 (partial degradation for a subset of customers). ETA for normal traffic: 30m, pending node reboot and verifying sustained stability.
Priya (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: continuous-batcher had an accumulator growth bug when prefetch hits a rare race — it keeps references to KV caches for evicted requests, which causes eventual host/GPU memory pressure and then CUDA OOMs. Weirdly, autoscaler made it worse by rescheduling more batch-workers into the same noisy node pool.
Jules (eng-sre): logging an incident ticket and tagging owners: runtime (Priya), infra (Diego), oncall (Sam). I'll collect debug traces and coredumps if any.
Diego (infra): plan: reboot gpu-node-7 after drain and upgrade kernel patch that includes a GPU page-fault mitigation from cloud provider. I'll coordinate with cloudops and schedule within 20m.
Sam (oncall): handing to Priya for post-mitigations and RCA. Priya, you're onpoint for follow-ups — Sam out in 40m.
Priya (eng-runtime): ack. I'll keep thread updated. Next steps: 1) replicate the accumulator growth locally with stress tool, 2) patch accumulator release logic, 3) add circuit-breaker in batcher to cap total KV cache memory, 4) add an emergency routing rule to divert to dedicated pool on similar future alerts.
Elena (support): customers want a postmortem and timeline. I'll prepare an external summary once we have RCA.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied — batcher replicas scaled to 1, prefetch disabled, infer-server routed to fallback model. Monitoring will auto-check for 15m stability window.
Priya (eng-runtime): quick ask — can eng-sre attach the container logs and coredumps to the ticket? will need them for the memory leak repro.
Jules (eng-sre): already collected and uploaded to artifacts: s3://redwood-incident-logs/1758765432/ — adding notes.
Sam (oncall): final note before handoff: keep an eye on p99 and OOM counts. If OOMs reappear, evict the pool and failover to dedicated-capacity for noisy customers.
Priya (eng-runtime): will follow up with a detailed RCA and release candidate patch. updating incident ticket with timeline and mitigation steps.
Elena (support): thanks all — I'll update the affected customers with the mitigation and expected RCA ETA.
Sam (oncall): handing off. signing out. :wave:
Priya (eng-runtime): taking over. monitoring.
